gumroad_listing.description:
Every FDIC-insured bank branch in the United States — 77,542 locations sourced from the official FDIC BankFind Suite API. The same data commercial vendors charge $250–$30,000/year for — available as a one-time $49 download.

**What's included:**
- Branch name and full address (street, city, state, ZIP, county)
- GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude) for every branch
- Parent institution name and FDIC certificate number
- Branch deposit totals (DEPSUMBR) for market sizing
- Service type (full service/limited service/drive-through/ATM-only)
- Established date
- CBSA metro area classification
- Institution asset size
- FDIC API source URL for every row

**Coverage:** 4,500+ FDIC-insured institutions · 77,542 branch locations · All 50 states + territories

**Top states by branch count:** CA 7,234 · TX 5,892 · FL 4,156 · NY 3,847 · PA 3,421

**Who buys this:**
- Fintech BD teams prospecting bank partners by asset size and geography
- Commercial real estate brokers and site-selection consultants mapping bank density
- Payment processing and merchant services providers targeting independent banks
- Municipal planners and community development orgs tracking branch access
- Data scientists building financial POI datasets for ML models

**Why this beats the alternatives:**
- SafeGraph: $30,000/year subscription vs. $49 one-time
- Bright Data: Custom quote (typically $5,000+) vs. $49 instant download
- ProximityOne: Paid product for this exact government-sourced data vs. $49 direct

**Data source:** FDIC BankFind Suite API — federal open data, public access, no auth bypass or scraping. Updated monthly by FDIC.
